hero_description.en: MTM 18+ is the largest and longest running study on media and technology among the adult Canadian population. By taking an exhaustive approach, it provides key insights to understand your audiences or users.

feature_1_description.en: MTM 18+ has been gathering data since 2001 on large array of topics.

feature_2_description.en: We've surveyed more than 300,000 adult Canadians to date and reach an additional 12,000 or more annually.

feature_3_description.en: Clients gain access to a full suite of more than 45 reports annually and thousands of variables across our suite of tools.

feature_4_description.en: All content available through MTM 18+ and the rest of the MTM product suite is offered in English and French.

feature_5_title.en: Data On Canadians From Coast To Coast To Coast

feature_5_description.en: The MTM offers data on every region and province, including the North.

tools_description.en: Explore our suite of tools and leverage data insights for confident decision-making on Canadian adults.

dat_description.en: The Data Analysis Tool (DAT) offers clients full access to our robust data set on Canadian adults. Tailor your analysis your way, filter the results, and create visually stunning outputs.

dat_callout.en:
Want to know Canadians are using connected TV sets?
All you need to know is a few clicks away with the DAT.

-.en:
Key Insight
Samsung is the most common TV set brand among Canadians.

trending_description.en: The Trending Tool lets clients see how technology and media adoption has shifted since 2010. Chart your path forward with 15+ years of data and demographic data filters.

trending_callout.en: How has TikTok grown? Past month usage has increased from 3% in Fall 2019 to 23% in Fall 2025.

forecasting_description.en: The Forecasting Tool is for clients with an eye on the past and the future. Easy to read charts and insights from our experts will help you stay ahead of your competition.

forecasting_callout.en:
Is Amazon Prime Video on-track to surpass Netflix?
Find out this and more with acccess to the Forecasting tool.

methodology_description.en: MTM 18+ is based on a nationally representative telephone survey with a follow up online compontent, reaching Canadian adults across all provinces and territories.

sample_stat_1_description.en: The largest on-going survey of its kind.

sample_stat_3_description.en: Large, viable samples for either Official Canadian language market.

survey_stat_3_description.en: Respondents complete a phone survey and an additional follow up online survey, with questions optomized for each medium

data_collected_description.en: Sample composition is weighted to reflect the national distribution of Canadian households.

provider_description.en:
The MTM and all of its surveys are a product of CBC/Radio-Canada Research and Analysis. Forum Research conducts all of the French and English research for the MTM 18+.

Established in 1993, Forum Research Inc. is a Canadian market research and technology company, with offices in Toronto, Montreal, and Saskatoon. With over 30 years of experience, they combine industry talent, cutting-edge technology, and behavioral science to provide in-depth insights.
